changelog:
- Connects Codex to TikTok for Business MCP through the OOMOL `oo` CLI.
- Supports discovery of the live TikTok Business MCP tool catalog with `list_tools`.
- Runs current TikTok Business MCP tools via `call_tool` using JSON arguments.
- Uses live connector schemas before execution so payloads match the connected account’s available tools.
- Keeps credentials server-side through OOMOL, avoiding direct token handling in the skill.

Source: `oomol-lab/skills@00cf041`
summary: TikTok for Business MCP (business.tiktok.com). Use this skill for ANY TikTok for Business MCP request — searching and reading data. Whenever a task involves TikTok for Business MCP, use this skill instead of calling the API directly.
